title: Southern Comfort Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Southern Comfort is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 49 VENICE CIRCLEIn the new section of Seaside close to the playground and pools, Southern Comfort is nestled on 49 Venice Circle, shielded from traffic and noise. Sleeps 14: Private bathroom for each bedroom, (bunk room has a half bath). 6 Br, 5 full Baths, 2 half baths (2 king, 3 queen,1 bunk room sleeps 4)3 car parking, digitally wired, 5 flat screens, full Washer/Dryer, outdoor grill. Fully equipped kitchen. One gas fireplace in den.This custom-designed French-inspired cottage is the perfect choice for the romantic atheart. Ideal for all occasions celebrating love and vows be it bridal showers, bachelorette/wedding parties, anniversaries, or other milestones. Great for family reunions and, of course, beach vacations.Southern Comfort cottage strives to please the most pampered guest. Every inch of this 2600 sq' interior is imbued with the authentic ambiance of a cottage one might find in the heart of Provence. It is an ongoing labor of love for the owner. Needless to say, it is at a standard well above a typical rental.The hearth and heart of the home is the kitchen/den where 14 plus people easily can gather. with comfortable seating for everyone. French doors open to a shaded porch with extra seating. A queen bedroom for the guest unable to navigate stairs is on this ground level. On the 2nd floor is the spacious King primary bedroom which has the space for a baby crib if needed. Here also is the 2nd queen bedroom, full washer and dryer.On the 3rd floor there are two suites. To the right is the queen bedroom. To the left is the king bedroom and adjacent to it is the bunk/sitting room (sleeps 4) which has one bunk and one queen sleeper sofa; this room has its own half bath, a tall chest of drawers but. no closet. This suite is particularly well suited for the parents of small children.Each bedroom is a cozy private retreat. Each has a luxurious bath with ample storage. Each has a comfortable chair or window seat for private pursuits. Closets and chests of drawers are in all bedrooms. Each has direct access to a small balcony (2) or a large covered porch (3).Southern Comfort's theme echoes the owner's childhood memories of visits to the French countryside. The decor is an eclectic melange of well-chosen pieces. Matisse inspires the richly hued color palette. Reminiscent of bygone days are the white marble baths, claw foottub, AGA stove & duvet-clad bedding. So come, step back into a simpler time and enjoy!* 5 night Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 2,600 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion5-minute, 352-yard walk to beach accessEach bedroom has a private bathSteps away from the fitness centerClose to adult and family poolsWasher & Dryer on second floorAGA range in kitchenAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.STR23-002010
